summary.text: Jennifer Decker is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 58 since 2021 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Decker is an attorney and business owner.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer Decker earned a B.A. and M.A. from Eastern Kentucky University and a J.D. from the University of Kentucky.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney, as executive director of Operation Care Inc., and as co-owner of Decker Quality Stock Farm.
She has volunteered with the Shelbyville Rotary Club, the Whitney M. Young Community Liaison Council, and the Cattlemen's Association.
Decker assumed office on January 1, 2021, succeeding Rob Rothenburger (R).

In the 2025-2026 session she was vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee and also served on the Elections, Constitutional Amendments & Intergovernmental Affairs, Postsecondary Education, and State Government committees.
